title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Noblewoman Rishe has her engagement to a crown prince annulled for the seventh time; in each of her six earlier lives, as merchant, herbalist, scholar, maid, hunter and knight, she died at twenty in a war started by the neighboring Galkhein Empire. In her seventh life, Galkhein's Crown Prince Arnold, who killed her in a past loop, proposes, and she accepts on her own terms, using her past-life skills to improve the empire and avert the war while wondering what made him cold.
life_message: Skills earned through hard work in every life can be used to change fate and help others.

content.note: War deaths in past loops; she was killed by Arnold in one (Wikipedia; MU Swordswoman).
Political marriage and growing romance (Wikipedia; AniList Heterosexual).
